upstreams.fields: per feed: provider, location, licence link, direct-download link, stop bounding box, status. The catalogue (metadata) is CC0 per github.com/MobilityData/mobility-database-catalogs; the feeds it points to keep their own publishers' terms.
upstreams.paidBy: Mobility Database — MobilityData (catalogue of open GTFS feeds, CC0 1.0)

paidBy: Mobility Database — MobilityData (catalogue of open GTFS feeds, CC0 1.0)

cadenceBasis.observed: measured 2026-11-21: the CSV is rewritten by MobilityData daily (object generation changes between fetches); feeds are added and retired weekly at most
cadenceBasis.expires: if the catalogue moves from files.mobilitydatabase.org or stops being published as CSV

autoRefresh: one key-free request for the catalogue CSV; the licence of every feed is re-classified from its link, so a feed whose licence link changed changes its verdict at the next run
schema: scripts/transit-discover.mjs --check (rows [id, country, provider, place, licenceUrl, spdx, verdict, downloadUrl, bbox]) — read by js/transit-catalogue.js
src: Mobility Database catalogue (feeds_v2.csv), filtered to active, key-free GTFS schedule feeds and classified by js/transit-licence.js — a verdict is the classification of the licence LINK the catalogue holds, not a reading of the publisher's terms

verdicts.usable-lead: the stated licence permits commercial use; the publisher's page has not been read
verdicts.unusable: the stated licence forbids commercial use or derivatives
verdicts.unknown: a licence page nobody has read
